data.name: EduMetrics
data.description: Student performance analytics platform that imports assessment files, normalizes data, and produces class insights and printable reports.
data.useCase: Schools can turn heterogeneous CSV, Excel, and ODS assessment data into student, subject, and term views.
data.stack: Python, FastAPI, pandas, React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Recharts
data.engineeringFocus: File-mapping workflows, deterministic analytics, report exports, and temporary upload cleanup.
data.imageAlt: Illustration of student assessment analytics with class performance charts.

data.name: React Movie App
data.description: Movie discovery sample integrating TMDB search and Appwrite-backed search analytics.
data.useCase: Explore movie information and trending searches in a responsive discovery interface.
data.stack: React 19, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Appwrite, TMDB API
data.engineeringFocus: Debounced API search, external service configuration, and persisted search analytics.
data.imageAlt: React Movie App hero and search interface

data.name: Weather Forecast and History
data.description: WeatherAPI sample that presents current conditions, a three-day forecast, and four days of historical data.
data.useCase: Search for a city and compare current, forecast, and recent historical weather.
data.stack: JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Node.js, Express, WeatherAPI
data.engineeringFocus: Server-side API-key handling and combining current, forecast, and historical responses.

data.name: Movie Watch List
data.description: A browser-based movie search and watchlist app using the OMDb API and local storage.
data.useCase: Search for movies, inspect details, and save titles to a personal watchlist.
data.stack: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, OMDb API, localStorage
data.engineeringFocus: REST API responses, client-side state persistence, and a two-page search/watchlist flow.
data.imageAlt: Illustration of a movie search and saved watchlist interface.

data.name: Cart-Menu
data.description: Restaurant menu and cart demo with item selection, order totals, and a simulated checkout flow.
data.useCase: Select menu items, adjust an order, review totals, and step through a demonstration checkout.
data.engineeringFocus: Client-side cart state, total calculation, input validation, and responsive presentation.
data.imageAlt: Food image from the Cart-Menu demo

data.name: Task List
data.description: React task-list app with task creation, completion, deletion, sorting, and animated visual feedback.
data.useCase: Organize tasks, mark completed items, and sort a personal task list.
data.engineeringFocus: Interactive component state, task sorting, and responsive UI behavior.
data.imageAlt: Illustration of a task organizer with a checklist and progress indicator.
